record_type_quote: Following our protocol and using the exact model shared in that paper, our primary aim in this study is to assess the prospective validity of mental health symptom prediction using the mindLAMP app through a replication study.

targets.title: Digital phenotyping data to predict symptom improvement and app personalization: protocol for a prospective study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly judge the primary model validation an overall success. Secondary activity recommendations were exploratory and not the replicated model finding.

reasoning: New independent sample prospectively tests the previously published prediction model. The cited protocol was checked directly: despite its protocol title it also reports fitted models and held-out AUC results from earlier college samples, including the improvement model tested here. It is therefore the identifiable publication of the model result, rather than a plan substituted for an original finding.
